title: Alpha Red #9 (Cover A)
ageRange: E – Everyone 5+ Suitable for all audiences
description:
Alpha Red finds himself in hot water with Peter, the Kingdom's senior leader. Thinking he has a few days off to enjoy Christmas, he's quickly reminded that evil never takes a holiday.
After enduring a grueling training session that pushes Alpha Red to his limits, Peter reveals a collection of top-secret files about Alpha Red's parents. Long before he became a hero, they served the Kingdom as legendary superheroes—until they were killed in the line of duty when he was only three years old.
For the first time, Alpha Red uncovers the truth about his parents' final Christmas Eve mission as they fought to save Diver City from Professor Polar, a brilliant but deranged scientist determined to plunge the entire city into an eternal deep freeze.
Don't miss this exciting glimpse into Alpha Red's past and discover the heroic legacy that shaped his future.
synopsis: This SUPER hero’s-journey follows ordinary contractor Calvin “Wes” Wesley as he finds himself called into the eternal battle between good and evil, becoming ALPHA RED!  Forty years ago, Satan was betrayed by his right-hand demon and cast into the body of a human, then cursed with immortality.  The Devil has been walking the earth for four decades plotting his revenge, but no one knows who he is or what he looks like.  Our hero gets a chip implanted in his brain that makes him super-strong, super-fast, and super-smart.  Wes must find the Enemy and stop him from taking over the world.  A cross between the Marvel Cinematic Universe, G.I. Joe, and Transformers, this story will make you laugh and make you cry.  It will have you routing for Alpha Red to find the strength to stop Satan and save the world!

title: PHANTOM HC VOL 36 THE COMPLETE NEWSPAPER DAILIES 1993-1994
seriesName: The Phantom: The Complete Newspaper Dailies
ageRange: T – Teen 13+ Suitable for teens, mild themes
description:
"Referred to by comic strip historian Maurice Horn as the “granddaddy of all costumed superheroes,” The Phantom was created in 1936 by Lee Falk. The strip hit the funny pages of newspapers well before the Dark Knight or Superman made their first appearances and has been acknowledged as an influence on every “masked man of mystery” since. The Phantom set the standard for action, adventure, intrigue, and romance in adventure comic strips and comic books — it has frequently been copied but never equaled. 
  This exciting 36th volume concludes the SY BARRY YEARS and ends with “The Phantom Cowboy,” credited to Sy and George Olesen and Keith Williams. Reprinted in all its black and white glory, journey with Hermes Press as we bring you five complete continuities drawn by Sy himself — and an assist in the last continuity, which continues the adventures of The Phantom, Diana, and his two children. Included in this volume are the following stories: The Moxley Awards (4/8 – 6/19/93); Nukes (6/21-11/13/93); Dinosaur (11/15/93 -2/12/94); The Plotters (2/14 -6/4/94) and The Phantom Cowboy (6/6 -12/17/94). Also included is a comprehensive essay, Sy Barry original artwork, and more."

title: As Above, So Below II
ageRange: T – Teen 13+ Suitable for teens, mild themes
description:
Consumed by anger and grief, Chance seeks revenge and pursues the demon that turned  his life upside down.  He later confronts him and is ready to give the killing blow that will deal his revenge when an angelic voice stops him in his tracks.  It is his beloved from beyond the grave that warns him to stop.  He reconsiders but it's too late.  The demon wants to finish the fight which ends badly.  Chance is sent to prison for the accidental death of Carl.  In time he becomes an old and broken man. Yearning to be reunited with his lost loves in the afterlife; Chance decides to end his life by jumping from a cliff.  

Manafest, Beserker of CHAOS, has finally bested Premonition Omicron after 10,000 years of fighting.  His power escapes from across the Cosmos and travels to the next hero fated to be the next Premonition.  

At that moment Chance plunges over the cliff, he is blasted with the Premonition power and the Fates of Destiny appear with an intriguing proposition: if he agrees to assist them in the battle against the evil that plagues the Cosmos, they will reset his timeline and bring his lost love and child back from the dead and thereby finish their Web of Fate.

Confused with this new power, Premonition falls into a psychic shop and meets someone destined to help aid him in discovering who he is.  At that moment he sees his first "premonition."  

CHAOS is free to ravage the Cosmos until only darkness remains.
synopsis:
In a time beyond Ragnarök, Zeus is dead, consumed by His hatred for mankind.  He sends a purge of fire to Earth before his demise.  With the imbalance between good and evil, cracks form across the Cosmic Egg of creation.  The Tree of Life, that grants life to all, slowly withers away. CHAOS, the Child of Darkness, is set loose, threatening to extinguish all life and light and plunge everything into nothingness.  Both Heaven and Hell lose sovereignty and evil spills out upon Earth.  The immortals begin falling one by one.  Desperation befalls the gods as they face extinction.  

The Fates of Destiny arrive at the birth of a baby boy, weaving their fate upon him only to realize his fate has already been woven with their own.  When the time is right, they will return to finish their web, thereby sealing his fate.
   
In the meantime, Chance, lives out his life in tragedy, unbeknownst of his life to come.  He lives a life of privilege until one day it all comes crashing down with the death of his true love and unborn child.  Consumed by anger and grief, he seeks vengeance and pursues the demon that destroyed his life.  

In time he becomes an old and broken man. Yearning to be reunited with his lost loves in the afterlife; Chance decides to end his life by jumping from a cliff.  At that moment, the Fates of Destiny appear with an intriguing proposition: if he agrees to assist them in the battle against the evil that plagues the Cosmos, they will reset his timeline and thereby finish their Web of Fate.

In a long succession of heroes, the Premonition power awakens across time when the Cosmos needs it most. The source of the power comes from the Tree of Life and is bestowed by the combined powers of the sisters of fate, the guardians of the Tree of Life. 
The Fates are seers of the past, present, and future and weave one’s fate at the time of their birth.  Rayvn is the weaver of fate.  Decima measures the length of the thread of one’s lifeline.  Morta is tasked to cut the thread of life, thereby sealing one’s fate.

Across the Cosmos, the former champion known as Premonition Omicron, has fallen. Finally defeated by henchman of Chaos, Manafest.  Premonition is defeated with the aid of Decima, the Fate of the Present, who has forsaken her sisters to join the fight against good. 
With Medusa now at the throne, Decima is promised a place in her dominion, leading to internal strife among the Fates of Destiny as they clash with Manafest.
With the death of Omicron, the Premonition power escapes into the Cosmos and takes with it the Fates of Destiny, who now bestow their combined powers onto Chance, and a new hero is born, the Yogen.   

He age-regresses to his younger self, becoming immortal– with one catch: his memory is lost, all but for his love.  The new Premonition grapples with a profound identity crisis, haunted by his true nature and lost love all while trying to learn his new powers, all in an effort, to stop the purge of fire from engulfing the planet.
Throughout this quest to reclaim his memories and understand his purpose, the Fates of Destiny reappear at different junctures, offering assistance and guidance to our reluctant hero.

Chance first finds solace in a gifted psychic, a descendant of the Oracle of Delphi, with the ability to commune with the dead and glimpse into realms beyond even Premonition's reach. 
This psychic becomes an essential ally, helping Chance comprehend the extent of his powers and aid him in his quest for self-discovery.  He is later catapulted into the past with a misstep in his initial battle with Manafest into a time of the Vikings, where he learns how to fight and wield his powers with the help of his inner light, the Mind's Eye.

Premonition later returns to the present after somewhat mastering his power and confronts Manafest and the purge of fire.  Other challenges arise. The fifth dimension is also threatened with the collapse of the third and sends its champion to combat CHAOS.  Later tricked by Manafest, our hero's heart is tainted by darkness, and he joins evil’s cause. 
Morta, the Fate of the Future, escapes to the Gates of Hades and traverses the underworld to resurrect Premonition Alpha to combat the newfound evil Premonition, Dark Heart. 
Over several battles, our hero's goodness is restored, allowing him to vanquish Manafest and other sworn foes summoned to defeat him.

This truly is a love story.  In the end, Premonition confronts CHAOS while fighting for his love.  Witnessing the hero's unwavering devotion, Zeus regains faith in and love for humanity which breaks Him free from Cupid’s spell, which had turned him into stone.
With renewed vigor, Zeus joins the battle, helping to subdue Chaos and reinstates the delicate balance between light and darkness.

Chance is returned to his former life, before the tragic accident that claimed his wife and child, while still retaining the Power of Premonition, that he employs to prevent the catastrophe. 
 
Throughout the story, Chance grapples with internal struggles between darkness and light, and external conflicts that challenge his resolve. Despite his increasing power, it is not mere strength that triumphs over darkness, but rather the hero's unwavering selfless love that ultimately saves the Cosmos as well as his soul and the lives of his loved ones. 

At the end there is a twist of fate where it appears this was all in Chance’s mind, as he lay dying, in the same car crash his wife and child die. But his wife and child survive, and it is their son that becomes the next Premonition.  Throughout the story there is many villains and side quests and lesser-known mythological and original characters interwoven in the story.

Getting in was the easy part.

synopsis:
Everybody wants out of something.

Escape New Jersey is an anthology series exploring the strange, dark and unexpected corners of the Garden State through a rotating cast of characters searching for a way out.

Sometimes escape means crossing the state line. Sometimes it's leaving a person, a place or a past behind. Sometimes the prison is inside your own head. And sometimes escape means confronting something that has been waiting for you longer than you've been alive.

Each story travels to a different corner of New Jersey with new characters, new dangers and a new meaning of the word escape.

Physical. Mental. Spiritual.

Different people. Different places. Different stories.

Same exit sign.

Welcome to Escape New Jersey.

Each story travels to a different corner of New Jersey with new characters, new dangers and a new meaning of the word escape.

Physical. Mental. Spiritual.

Different people. Different places. Different stories.

Same exit sign.

Welcome to Escape New Jersey.

title: ESCAPE NEW JERSEY #1

description:
Mel has one night to get her son out of New Jersey.

With her abusive husband closing in, a borrowed Chevy running on fumes, and a winter storm swallowing the roads behind them, Mel, Junior and Ash are racing for the state line.

But people have been trying to escape this land for centuries.
Something old is stirring beneath the snow—and the farther they run from Mel's past, the deeper they drive into someone else's.

Part supernatural horror. Part road movie. All New Jersey.

Getting in was the easy part.

ESCAPE NEW JERSEY.
